title: Indian tech tycoon bets $30M of his own money to build AI alternative to Microsoft Office
author: [[Jagmeet Singh]]
description: Neo is Bhavin Turakhia’s fifth venture and his latest involving enterprise software. This time he's taking on Microsoft Office, Google Apps with AI.

title: Cloudflare’s new policy pushes AI companies to pay for publishers’ content
author: [[Sarah Perez]]
description: Cloudflare is giving AI companies until September 15 to separate web crawlers used for search from those used for AI training and agents, or risk being blocked by default on many publisher sites.

title: SpaceX has an AI device prototype, and it sure sounds phone-ish
author: [[Rebecca Bellan]]
description: SpaceX reportedly showed investors a "handset-like" AI device before going public. It could be another signal SpaceX wants to expand into wireless.

title: Ashton Kutcher leaving Sound Ventures to launch new VC firm with Morgan Beller
author: [[Marina Temkin]]
description: Sound built its reputation on concentrated, high-conviction bets in category-leading AI labs, while Kutcher's new fund appears to be chasing the layer underneath those companies — the infrastructure and energy that power them.

title: Neocloud Together AI raises $800M, leaps to $8.3B valuation
author: [[Julie Bort]]
description: The AI neocloud provider, which specializes in hosting open source models, last raised at a $3.3 billion valuation in early 2025.

title: Meta, like SpaceX, looks to turn excess AI compute into cash
author: [[Rebecca Bellan]]
description: Meta is developing plans for a cloud infrastructure business, selling access to AI compute power and models. The move would pit it against the big cloud providers like Amazon Web Services, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.

title: Gemini Spark, Google’s agentic assistant, is now available on Mac
author: [[Sarah Perez]]
description: Google's 24/7 agentic assistant, Gemini Spark, comes to Mac alongside other improvements, like real-time tracking and support for more apps.

title: Builders Stage agenda revealed: Practical strategies for scaling startups at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026
author: [[TechCrunch Events]]
description: The Builders Stage is returning to TechCrunch Disrupt 2026, bringing together 10,000+ founders, startup operators, and investors for practical conversations. and Q&A on what it takes to build and scale successful companies. Register now to save up to $330.

title: After $18B IPO, Bending Spoons founder says success comes from minimizing luck
author: [[Anna Heim]]
description: The co-founders of Bending Spoons, the Italian company quietly buying beloved, ailing Internet brands, learned big lessons from their own startup's failure.

title: Venice AI becomes a unicorn with $65M Series A as its privacy-first AI platform takes off
author: [[Ram Iyer]]
description: Venice AI is already profitable, with annualized run-rate revenues of over $70 million, CEO Erik Voorhees said.
